quote: Trying to produce output (e.g. with `echo`) within a user output handler is deprecated.
reason: Whether a handler prints depends on its body and on when it runs, usually a callback named by a string or array; the fixture shows ob_end_flush() raising the notice from 8.5 for a named handler that echoes.

quote: Non-canonical cast names (boolean), (integer), (double), and (binary) have been deprecated, use (bool), (int), (float), and (string) respectively.
reason: Already covered by the existing rule in Casts.php with four verified fixtures (deprecated 8.5); nothing new written.

quote: The $exclude_disabled parameter of the get_defined_functions() function has been deprecated, as it no longer has any effect since PHP 8.0.
reason: Any argument raises the notice on 8.5; the runtimes showed that a literal false already raised it from 8.0 ("Setting $exclude_disabled to false has no effect"), so false is reported as deprecated in 8.0 and any other argument as 8.5.

quote: Terminating case statements with a semicolon instead of a colon has been deprecated.
reason: Already covered by the existing rule CaseSemicolon.php with a verified fixture (deprecated 8.5); nothing new written.

quote: The backtick operator as an alias for shell_exec() has been deprecated.
reason: Already covered by the existing rule Backtick.php with a verified fixture (deprecated 8.5); nothing new written.

quote: Returning null from __debugInfo() has been deprecated.
reason: Reported at a literal "return null;" or bare "return;" directly in __debugInfo() (notice when var_dump() reads the object, from 8.5); a null from a variable or call is not visible and is not reported.

quote: The report_memleaks INI directive has been deprecated.
reason: INI directive for debug builds; the runtimes showed that only ini_set() to a non-default value ("0"/"Off") raises the notice on 8.5 while setting the default "1" or ini_get() raises nothing; plugin code has no reason to set it, so no rule.

quote: Constant redeclaration has been deprecated.
reason: The runtimes contradict the notes: redeclaring a constant with define() or const raises E_NOTICE on 7.4 and E_WARNING on 8.0-8.5 ("this will be an error in PHP 9" on 8.5), never E_DEPRECATED; whether define() runs twice depends on run-time flow, so nothing is reported.

quote: Enacted the follow-up phase of the "Path to Saner Increment/Decrement operators" RFC, meaning that incrementing non-numeric strings is now deprecated.
reason: Depends on the value of the variable being incremented; the existing fixture runtime.string_increment~8.3-alphanumeric shows 'abc'++ raising the notice from 8.5 (only the empty and non-alphanumeric cases started in 8.3).

quote: The following closure binding issues, which already emit an E_WARNING, are now deprecated:
reason: The runtimes contradict the notes: binding an instance to a static closure and binding to the scope of an internal class still raise E_WARNING on 8.5 (now worded "this will be an error in PHP 9"), no E_DEPRECATED; the closure and the target are run-time values, so nothing is reported.

quote: Using null as an array offset or when calling array_key_exists() is now deprecated.
reason: Literal null as an offset (read, write, isset, empty, ??), as an array or list() key, and as the key of array_key_exists()/key_exists() (rule argument.array_key_exists_null) is reported from 8.5; unset($a[null]) raised nothing and is not reported, $this[null] is skipped for ArrayAccess, a string literal receiver ("abc"[null] raised a warning, not this notice) is skipped, and a null held in a variable is runtime-only (runtime.null_array_offset_variable).

quote: Deriving $_SERVER['argc'] and $_SERVER['argv'] from the query string for non-CLI SAPIs has been deprecated.
reason: Concerns non-CLI SAPIs and the register_argc_argv INI setting; the CLI runtimes here cannot show it and source code reading $_SERVER['argv'] is fine under CLI.

quote: The __sleep() and __wakeup() magic methods have been soft-deprecated.
reason: Soft deprecation only: the fixture shows serialize()/unserialize() with __sleep()/__wakeup() raising nothing on any version up to 8.5, so the scanner reports nothing for it.

quote: The curl_close() function has been deprecated, as CurlHandle objects are freed automatically.
reason: curl_close is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.5, verified).

quote: The curl_share_close() function has been deprecated, as CurlShareHandle objects are freed automatically.
reason: curl_share_close is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.5, verified).

quote: The DATE_RFC7231 and DateTimeInterface::RFC7231 constants have been deprecated.
reason: DATE_RFC7231 is in data/catalog/constants.php (constant.deprecated, 8.5, verified); the class constant through DateTimeInterface::, DateTime:: or DateTimeImmutable:: is reported by the new rule Php85DepClassConstants (all three raise "Constant DateTimeInterface::RFC7231 is deprecated" on 8.5).

quote: The __wakeup() magic method of DateTimeInterface, DateTime, DateTimeImmutable, DateTimeZone, DateInterval, and DatePeriod has been deprecated in favour of the __unserialize() magic method.
reason: Only an explicit ->__wakeup() call raises it (unserialize() of DateTime and of a subclass whose __wakeup() calls parent::__wakeup() raised nothing, since __unserialize() is used); the receiver's class is not known from the syntax tree, and on DateTime/DateTimeZone the call is already fatal on every version.

quote: The finfo_close() function has been deprecated.
reason: finfo_close is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.5, verified).

quote: The $context parameter of the finfo_buffer() and finfo::buffer() functions has been deprecated as it is ignored.
reason: finfo_buffer() with a fourth argument is reported whatever its value; finfo::buffer() with a third argument only where the receiver is known to be new finfo() (local variable or $this property), since buffer() is a common method name.

quote: The imagedestroy() function has been deprecated, as GdImage objects are freed automatically.
reason: imagedestroy is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.5, verified).

quote: The MHASH_* constants have been deprecated.
reason: MHASH_* constants exist only when PHP is built with mhash support; defined('MHASH_MD5') is false on every runtime here, so nothing can be verified.

quote: The intl.error_level INI setting has been deprecated.
reason: INI setting of the intl extension, which none of the runtimes here has.

quote: The mysqli_execute() alias function has been deprecated.
reason: mysqli_execute is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.5, verified).

quote: The $key_length parameter for openssl_pkey_derive() has been deprecated.
reason: Any third argument raises the notice on 8.5, including 0 (checked with 32, 16 and 0); reported when the argument is written in the call.

quote: The "uri:" DSN scheme has been deprecated due to security concerns with DSNs coming from remote URIs.
reason: new PDO() whose DSN (positional or named dsn:) is written as a string starting with "uri:" (also as the left end of a concatenation or the literal start of an interpolated string) is reported; a DSN from a variable is not visible.

quote: Driver specific constants in the PDO class have been deprecated.
reason: The 15 PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_* and 7 PDO::SQLITE_* constants the runtimes define were each shown deprecated on 8.5 and are reported (guarded in the else branch of a Pdo\Mysql/Pdo\Sqlite check); DBLIB, FB, ODBC and PGSQL constants are not defined here, MYSQL_ATTR_MAX_BUFFER_SIZE/READ_DEFAULT_FILE/READ_DEFAULT_GROUP are libmysql-only and MYSQL_ATTR_LOCAL_INFILE_DIRECTORY (8.1+) has no fixture that runs on 7.4, so those are not reported.

quote: Driver specific methods in the PDO class have been deprecated.
reason: sqliteCreateFunction(), sqliteCreateCollation() and sqliteCreateAggregate() were shown deprecated on 8.5 and are reported by name (not on $this, not in a file declaring a method of that name); the pgsql*() methods cannot be shown without pdo_pgsql and are not reported.

quote: The setAccessible() methods of various Reflection objects have been deprecated, as those no longer have an effect.
reason: ReflectionProperty::setAccessible() and ReflectionMethod::setAccessible() raise the notice on 8.5; reported by method name with exactly one argument (the Reflection signature), except on $this or in a file that declares setAccessible(); a PHP version check marks it guarded.

quote: Calling ReflectionClass::getConstant() for constants that do not exist has been deprecated.
reason: Depends on whether the constant exists in the reflected class, which is a run-time fact.

quote: Calling ReflectionProperty::getDefaultValue() for properties without default values has been deprecated.
reason: Depends on the reflected property; the runtimes showed the notice only for a typed property without default (an untyped property has an implicit null default and raised nothing).

quote: Unregistering all autoloaders by passing the spl_autoload_call() function as a callback argument to spl_autoload_unregister() has been deprecated.
reason: spl_autoload_unregister() with the string 'spl_autoload_call' (any case, optional leading backslash) is reported; a callback held in a variable is not visible.

quote: The SplObjectStorage::contains(), SplObjectStorage::attach(), and SplObjectStorage::detach() methods have been deprecated in favour of SplObjectStorage::offsetExists(), SplObjectStorage::offsetSet(), and SplObjectStorage::offsetUnset() respectively.
reason: Reported only where the receiver is certainly an SplObjectStorage (new SplObjectStorage() in the same function, a parameter or property declared with that type, $this/parent:: in a direct subclass that does not override the method), because attach()/detach()/contains() are common names (SplSubject, collections); top-level code is not looked at.

quote: Using ArrayObject and ArrayIterator with objects has been deprecated.
reason: new ArrayObject/ArrayIterator/RecursiveArrayIterator with new X(), $this, an (object) cast or a closure written as the first argument is reported (even an ArrayObject or ArrayIterator passed in raised it); an object held in a variable, and exchangeArray(), are runtime-only (runtime.arrayobject_object_variable).

quote: The socket_set_timeout() alias function has been deprecated.
reason: socket_set_timeout is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.5, verified).

quote: Passing null to to readdir(), rewinddir(), and closedir() to use the last opened directory has been deprecated.
reason: Calling readdir(), rewinddir() or closedir() with no argument raises the same "Passing null is deprecated" notice on 8.5 as a literal null, so both are reported; a null from a variable is not visible.

quote: Passing integers outside the interval [0, 255] to chr() is now deprecated.
reason: A literal integer above 255 or below 0 is reported; a computed value is runtime-only (runtime.chr_out_of_range_variable).

quote: Passing a string which is not a single byte to ord() is now deprecated, this is indicative of a bug.
reason: A literal string of zero or more than one byte is reported (the empty string has its own notice on 8.5); a string from a variable, such as a multibyte character, is runtime-only (runtime.ord_not_one_byte_variable).

quote: The locally predefined variable $http_response_header is deprecated.
reason: Compile-time notice for each read of the variable (also in never-called functions, via global/static, foreach into it, and as an argument of a method, a constructor or a function PHP does not know when compiling the call) until the same scope has assigned it in source order; isset(), empty(), ??, ++, unset(), closure use and by-reference internal arguments raised nothing and are not reported, nor are reads after an assignment in that scope.

quote: The xml_parser_free() function has been deprecated, as XMLParser objects are freed automatically.
reason: xml_parser_free is in data/catalog/functions.php (deprecated 8.5, verified).
